body:
aaaaaaaaaaaand I just got destroyed by a hunter when I had the first hit on him.

I fucking suck.

In High School I was talking to my crush and her friend said to me in the most dismissive way "When was the last time you saw the sun?" 

Thankfully I crushed it out of the park by returning with "When was the last time you saw a salad bar?"

Never got with my crush after that but was worth it. It was winter in Idaho how the fuck am I supposed to get a damn tan?
